import datetime,json,os,re
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
from src.tools import g01_collect_parallel as collect
from src.envs import pair_v2_g01_policy as policy
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve()
NAME="diag_g01_next12_03_plan_01"
assert os.environ["CVPR_RUN_NAME"]==NAME
scenes=[f"FloorPlan{i}" for i in (*range(14,20),*range(214,220))]
collect.validate_selection(scenes,6)
errors=[]
matches={scene:[] for scene in scenes}
source_index=[]
for path in sorted((ROOT/"results").rglob("*")):
 if not path.is_file() or not (path.name.endswith(".json") or path.name.endswith(".json.gz")):
  continue
 if not path.name.startswith(("pilot_pairs_","gen_train_")):
  continue
 m=re.search(r"floorplan([0-9]+)(?=[_.]|$)",path.name)
 if not m or "FloorPlan"+m[1] not in matches:
  continue
 scene="FloorPlan"+m[1]
 entry={"file":str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),"sha256":sha_file(path)}
 matches[scene].append(entry)
 source_index.append(entry)
records=[]
modern=[]
for scene,paths in matches.items():
 for item in paths:
  try:
   data,reference=audited_result(ROOT/item["file"])
   assert data["config"].get("scene")==scene and data["_meta"].get("end")
   cfg,met=data["config"],data["metrics"]
   command=data["_meta"]["command"]
   module=command[command.index("-m")+1] if "-m" in command else None
   is_modern=module=="src.envs.pair_v2_g01_shard" or "pair_v2" in str(module)
   if is_modern: modern.append(reference)
   visits=[]
   for visit in met.get("controller_visits",[]):
    visits.append({k:visit.get(k) for k in ("controller_id","preflight_passed","preflight_reference","preflight_measurements")})
   records.append({"scene":scene,"source":reference,"producer_module":module,
     "source_policy":cfg.get("policy"),"field_of_view":cfg.get("field_of_view"),
     "source_family":"v2_or_G01" if is_modern else "legacy_v1",
     "metrics":{k:met.get(k) for k in ("status","attempts","scene_excluded","scene_failures","error","discard_reason_counts","counts_by_class","passed_by_class","black_frame_detected")},
     "controller_preflight_records":visits})
  except Exception as exc:
   errors.append({"source":item,"error":type(exc).__name__+": "+str(exc)})
prior,prior_ref=audited_result(ROOT/"results/diag_g01_next_scene_plan_01.json")
assert prior["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0
prefix="G01_NEXT_SCENE_RECOMMENDATION_JSON: "
lines=[line[len(prefix):] for line in (ROOT/prior["_meta"]["log_path"]).read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith(prefix)]
assert len(lines)==1
previous_plan=json.loads(lines[0])
known_exclusions=previous_plan["known_prior_exclusions"]
known_baseline_errors=previous_plan["known_prior_baseline_errors_not_selected"]
assert not set(scenes)&set(known_exclusions+known_baseline_errors)
old,old_ref=audited_result(ROOT/"results/gen_train_next12_60_01_retry1.json")
assert old["_meta"].get("end")
cfg=old["config"]
assert cfg["gpus"]==1 and cfg["concurrencies"]==[6] and cfg["field_of_view"]==60
assert cfg["cpu_cores_per_gpu"]==12 and cfg["scene_timeout_seconds"]==1200
assert cfg["timeout_seconds"]==2860 and cfg["required_timeout_seconds"]==2860
assert cfg["submission"]["requested_wall_seconds"]==2890
assert cfg["benchmark_selection"]["concurrency"]==6
benchmark,benchmark_ref=audited_result(ROOT/cfg["benchmark_source"])
for key in ("file","sha256","metrics_sha256","git_commit","exit_code"):
 assert benchmark_ref[key]==cfg["benchmark_selection"]["source"][key]
assert [s for s in benchmark["metrics"]["stages"] if s["concurrency"]==6][0]["completed"] is True
payload_path=ROOT/cfg["submission"]["file"]
assert sha_file(payload_path)==cfg["submission"]["sha256"]
payload=json.loads(payload_path.read_bytes())
assert payload["requested_host"] is None and payload["requested_gpu_count"]==1
assert payload["requested_wall_seconds"]==2890 and payload["queue"]=="autox"
parent_timeout=collect.required_timeout(scenes,6)
assert parent_timeout==2860 and collect.parent.capacity(6)==2
prior_requests=[]
for path in sorted((ROOT/"logs/pbs").glob("*/payload.json")):
 data=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
 if data.get("dry_run"): continue
 command=data.get("command",[])
 if not isinstance(command,list): continue
 overlap=[scene for scene in scenes if scene in command]
 if overlap and data.get("name","").startswith(("pilot_pairs_","gen_train_")):
  prior_requests.append({"file":str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),"sha256":sha_file(path),
    "name":data.get("name"),"matching_scenes":overlap,"command":command,
    "scope":"recorded historical request only; no scheduler state queried"})
newer_exclusions=[r for r in records if r["source_family"]=="v2_or_G01" and
 (r["metrics"]["scene_excluded"] is not None or any(v["preflight_passed"] is False for v in r["controller_preflight_records"]))]
recommendation_ready=not errors and not modern and not newer_exclusions
out={"at_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 "name":NAME,"scope":"Fixed bounded next training-exploration batch; no scheduler/budget-state query, GPU submission, outcome estimate, threshold or source mutation",
 "proposed_run_name":"gen_train_next12_60_03","proposed_scenes":scenes,
 "training_split":{"declared_policy_version":policy.VERSION,"all_proposed_in_fixed_train80":True,
 "training_ranges":["1-20","201-220","301-320","401-420"],"evaluation_scenes_selected":[]},
 "rule_and_code_references":[{"file":file,"sha256":sha_file(ROOT/file)} for file in
 ("AGENTS.md","tasks/G01.md","tasks/T01v2.md","src/envs/pair_v2_g01_policy.py","src/tools/g01_collect_parallel.py","src/tools/g01_parallel.py","src/tools/g01_admission.py")],
 "matching_scene_source_search":matches,
 "search_scope":"all results/ and archived results/ filenames beginning pilot_pairs_ or gen_train_ containing the exact floorplan number, including .json/.json.gz; absence is absence from this recorded per-scene source catalog, not proof the scene is viable",
 "historical_evidence":records,"historical_v2_or_G01_sources":modern,
 "known_prior_scene_recommendation":prior_ref,
 "known_prior_exclusions_not_selected":known_exclusions,
 "known_prior_baseline_errors_not_selected":known_baseline_errors,
 "known_current_preflight_exclusions_in_selected_scenes":newer_exclusions,
 "recorded_payload_scene_overlap":prior_requests,
 "interpretation":{"kitchens":"No source means unmeasured scene preflight/candidate viability, not known-good.",
 "legacy_living":"Legacy v1 rejection reasons are retained verbatim. Its baseline_not_settled_or_native_collision test is the superseded collision/original-baseline method, not an independent current settled-baseline preflight exclusion. Do not silently call these scenes never attempted.",
 "selection":"Fixed human-specified training scene ranges, not selected by evaluation or predicted pair yield; no replacements without explicit current preflight evidence.",
 "current_collection":"No modern source is inferred from missing artifacts; each original current preflight and science gate still runs."},
 "settings_source":old_ref,"benchmark_source":benchmark_ref,
 "launch_settings":{"gpus":1,"cpu_cores_per_gpu":12,"concurrency":6,"max_shared_witnesses":2,
 "max_Unity_instances":8,"field_of_view":60,"seed":0,"scene_timeout_seconds":1200,
 "parent_timeout_seconds":parent_timeout,"PBS_wall_seconds":2890,
 "rate1_requested_allocation_GPUh_upper_bound":2890/3600,
 "rounded_up_requested_ceiling_GPUh":0.803,"queue":"autox","project":"CFP04-SF-125","requested_host":None,
 "producer_module":policy.PRODUCER,"entry_module":collect.MODULE,"benchmark_source_file":cfg["benchmark_source"]},
 "proposed_command":["python3","-u","-m",collect.MODULE,"--name","gen_train_next12_60_03","--scenes",*scenes,
 "--concurrency","6","--benchmark-source",cfg["benchmark_source"],"--timeout-seconds","2860"],
 "ready_for_root_budget_check":recommendation_ready,"errors":errors,
 "submission_conditions":["Root must run existing measured-plus-reserved charged budget guard before submission.",
 "Night GPU cap stays20; no cumulative budget conclusion is made here.",
 "No host constraint; original per-allocation render gate and confirmed cleanup remain mandatory.",
 "All original failed sources retained; construct qualification remains separate from T02/cache/training acceptance."],
 "night_cap_GPUh_unchanged":20,"full1700_goal_authorized_or_promised":False,
 "GPU_submitted":False,"budget_state_queried":False,"code_changed":False,"STATUS_changed":False}
print("G01_NEXT12_03_PLAN_JSON: "+json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
assert recommendation_ready, "Historical source/eligibility ambiguity: root must inspect before submission"
config.scope: environment setup or diagnostic, not a research result
